thematiq: rondleiding door het appmenu,: thematiq: apps menu walkthrough, step 6, create
De plus in de bovenbalk begint een nieuw: The plus in the top bar starts a new document, spreadsheet, presentation or whiteboard. The file lands in your own folder and opens at once. More shows everything else Nextcloud can create. Your admin can also place these buttons as a row at the bottom of the menu.
